title: 容器編排叢集
summary: 以宣告式控制、排程與工作負載隔離連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect declarative control, scheduling and workload isolation through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 控制平面與宣告
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「控制平面與宣告」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop control plane and declarations through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 宣告狀態：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「宣告狀態」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for desired state.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「宣告狀態」的資料、控制與時間關係。宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫 reconcile 的迭代。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for desired state. Desired and observed state may temporarily differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw reconciliation iterations. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有 running pod 都已可對使用者提供服務。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Every running pod is ready for users. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「宣告狀態」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit desired state two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 宣告狀態的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。
knowledge.textEn: Desired and observed state may temporarily differ.

knowledge.title: 宣告狀態的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 畫 reconcile 的迭代。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Draw reconciliation iterations. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設四節點各 8 CPU，每節點保留 1 CPU，allocatable 合計 28 CPU。每個不可跨節點拆分的 pod request 2 CPU，單節點只能放 floor(7/2)=3 個，四節點最多 12 個；14 個 pod 雖需合計 28 CPU，仍確定無法全部排程。拓撲、記憶體與裝置限制可能使上限更低。
knowledge.textEn: Four assumed 8-CPU nodes reserve 1 CPU each, totaling 28 allocatable CPUs. Each indivisible 2-CPU-request pod fits on one node: floor(7/2)=3 pods/node and at most 12 across four nodes. Fourteen pods need 28 CPU in aggregate but definitely cannot all schedule; topology, memory or device constraints may lower the bound further.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「容器編排叢集」的「宣告狀態：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「可信服務：中斷後的交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Desired state: principles and architecture” in “Container-orchestration clusters”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 本步審查「宣告狀態」與整體「容器編排叢集」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing desired state within container-orchestration clusters, which statement or check is supported?
options: 宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。
所有 running pod 都已可對使用者提供服務。
CPU 總量吻合就能忽略 affinity 排程。
optionsEn: Desired and observed state may temporarily differ.
Every running pod is ready for users.
Matching CPU totals permits ignoring affinity.
quiz.explanation: 宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。 畫 reconcile 的迭代。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Desired and observed state may temporarily differ. Draw reconciliation iterations. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 宣告狀態：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「畫 reconcile 的迭代。」檢查「宣告狀態」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for desired state using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「宣告狀態」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫 reconcile 的迭代。 核對「宣告期望與實際狀態會短暫不同。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for desired state and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw reconciliation iterations. Check the principle: Desired and observed state may temporarily differ. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有 running pod 都已可對使用者提供服務。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Every running pod is ready for users. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「宣告狀態」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫 reconcile 的迭代。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit desired state input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
